text: APPROVE. The extraction keeps the original order (templates, then style objects, then animate) and the same conditions and `continue` logic, and it leaves `InScript` with only two top-level `if`s, so complexity should fall well below 15. I could not compile it, and the one residual risk is the new parameter types such as `IReadOnlySet<string>` for `guards`, which I assumed match what `GuardBindings` returns and what `ReadsGuard` and `ScriptGuarded` accept.
